# Digi Web Crew

> A senior engineering team that builds custom software, high-performance websites, and AI automation for companies in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. Founded and led by Toqeer Shafique.

## What we do

Digi Web Crew is a development agency, not a template shop. Work is scoped around business outcomes — qualified leads, faster sites, automated operations — and built by senior engineers rather than assembled from themes.

Primary markets: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia.
Strongest client fit: law firms, medical and dental clinics, home services, consultancies, SaaS companies, and education businesses.

- **Custom software development**: https://digiwebcrew.com/services/custom-software

- **DevOps and cloud infrastructure**: https://digiwebcrew.com/services/devops-cloud
- **Internal tools and process automation**: https://digiwebcrew.com/services/automation-internal-tools
- **Website maintenance and support**: https://digiwebcrew.com/services/maintenance-support

## Pricing

Starting prices, not fixed packages. Final scope determines the quote.

- Custom website development: from $3,500
- Conversion funnels and landing pages: from $2,000
- Chatbot and automation projects: from $2,500
- SEO and growth retainers: from $1,000 per month

Full detail: https://digiwebcrew.com/pricing

## Technical stack

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL
- Frameworks: Next.js, React, Node.js
- Data: PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis
- Infrastructure: Docker, nginx, Cloudflare, self-managed Linux hosting
- Commerce: Shopify, headless commerce
- CMS: WordPress where a page builder serves the client better than a custom build

## How we work

Projects move through discovery, scope, build, and launch or growth support. Clients own their code. Engagements can be a single focused project or an ongoing retainer, and many clients start with one service and expand.
